html:
Binh Ba Island, located in Cam Ranh Bay of Khanh Hoa Province, is one of the most appealing coastal destinations in Vietnam. Known for its clear water, quiet beaches, and fresh seafood, the island offers a different experience compared to more commercial tourist areas.

This guide provides detailed and practical information to help you plan your trip, along with professional travel support from Vietlook Travel.

How to Get to Binh Ba Island

Traveling to Binh Ba Island involves two main steps: reaching Cam Ranh and then transferring to the island.

From major cities to Cam Ranh

You can travel to Cam Ranh in several ways:

  • By air: Direct flights to Cam Ranh International Airport are available from Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, and other major cities.
  • By train: Stop at Nha Trang or Thap Cham station, then continue by road.
  • By private car: A suitable option for families, groups, or business trips that require flexibility.

Vietlook Travel provides nationwide car rental and transfer services, ensuring timely pick-up, professional drivers, and well-maintained vehicles.

From Cam Ranh to Ba Ngoi Port

Ba Ngoi Port is about 15 kilometers from Cam Ranh city center. The journey takes approximately 20 to 30 minutes by car.

Vietlook Travel can arrange direct transfers from the airport, hotel, or any location to the port, helping you avoid delays and unnecessary waiting time.

Boat transfer to the island

From Ba Ngoi Port, you will take a boat to Binh Ba Island. The travel time is around 15 to 30 minutes depending on the type of boat.

Vietlook Travel supports booking boat tickets in advance, including private speedboat options for groups or travelers who prefer a more flexible schedule.

Best Time to Visit Binh Ba Island

The most suitable time to visit Binh Ba Island is from March to September. During this period, the weather is stable, the sea is calm, and the water is clear.

From October to February, the area is affected by wind and rough sea conditions, which may disrupt travel plans.

For a comfortable experience, it is recommended to plan your trip early, especially during weekends and public holidays.

Things to Do in Binh Ba Island

Enjoy the beaches

Binh Ba has several beaches with different characteristics:

  • Bai Nom: The most popular beach with clear water and convenient services
  • Bai Chuong: A good place to watch the sunrise
  • Bai Nha Cu: Quiet and less crowded, suitable for relaxation

Snorkeling and swimming

The island has areas with coral reefs and marine life. Visitors can swim or snorkel in designated zones. It is advisable to use proper equipment and follow local safety instructions.

Explore the island

You can rent a motorbike or arrange a private tour to explore the island. The roads are relatively easy to travel and offer views of the sea, fishing villages, and daily local life.

Vietlook Travel provides private car services and guided tours for visitors who prefer a structured and comfortable experience.

Experience local life

Binh Ba is still largely a fishing community. Visitors can observe or participate in daily activities such as fishing, seafood trading, and food preparation.

This is one of the most authentic aspects of traveling to the island.

Evening activities

In the evening, the island becomes quieter. Popular activities include walking along the beach, enjoying seafood dinners, or joining small group gatherings.

Local Cuisine in Binh Ba

Seafood is the highlight of Binh Ba Island. Most dishes are prepared using freshly caught ingredients.

Some popular dishes include:

  • Grilled lobster
  • Steamed squid
  • Grilled scallops with scallion oil
  • Seafood hotpot
  • Fresh oysters and sea urchin

Vietlook Travel can recommend reliable dining locations and arrange meals for groups when required.

Accommodation Options

Binh Ba offers basic but comfortable accommodation options such as:

  • Local guesthouses
  • Homestays
  • Small hotels near the sea

Although the island is not heavily developed, most places provide essential services for a short stay.

Vietlook Travel supports advance booking to ensure availability, especially during peak travel periods.

Important Travel Notes

  • Bring valid identification documents
  • Prepare cash as electronic payment is not widely available
  • Check weather conditions before departure
  • Follow local regulations and respect the environment
  • Book transportation and accommodation in advance when traveling during busy periods
